notes_for_editor: The White Oak half rests on the FFLOS register, which the association list agrees with on removal (the list marks the White Oak Mountain site as Tower Gone). The Hawthorne half rests on one FFLA list entry, which gives coordinates and a county but no date or mover, and sits under the Relocated / Replica Lookouts heading, so the list does not say whether the tower was moved or replicated. Two searches turned up no Hawthorne-specific page. The register describes a conversion and removal with no mention of moving. Access, staffing and current condition are unknown. No photos found.
